messages:
Samira (People Ops): Thanks everyone for coming to the all-hands — starting this thread for follow-ups on leveling, promotions, and comp questions. Drop anything we missed and we'll reply here.
Diego: Quick Q — when exactly is the next promotion window? the roadmap slide said Q3 but not a date.
Samira (People Ops): Good call — official window opens Sep 12 and closes Oct 3. Calibration happens Oct 10-17. We’ll post the form next week.
Olivia: Are managers allowed to nominate someone outside the window in urgent cases?
Maya (People Ops): Short answer: usually no. Exceptions are rare and need VP sign-off + justification. If you think it's critical, DM me and include impact + example outputs.
Ben: How should ICs submit evidence? is it just a self-nom form or do we attach docs?
Maya (People Ops): There will be a self-nom field plus attachments. Best practice: 1) 1-paragraph summary of impact, 2) 2-3 artifacts (PR links, dashboards, customer feedback), 3) manager blurb. We’ll paste a template below.
HR Bot: Reminder: Promotion self-nomination form will be available at https://redwood.internal/promote starting 2026-09-12.
Leah: Template pls — that'd help managers prep faster.
Maya (People Ops): Template (copy/paste) —
```
Title: Role applying for
Summary (1 paragraph):
Key impacts (bulleted):
Representative work (links):
Metrics / customer impact:
Manager endorsement (1-2 lines):
```
Johan: Thanks — will managers get calibration training? last time it felt a bit fuzzy.
Samira (People Ops): Yes — we’re running two 45-min calibration workshops: Sep 22 (Americas/EMEA) and Sep 23 (APAC). Attendance expected for all people managers involved in promotions.
Diego: About comp — any guidance on mid-cycle salary adjustments for high performers?
Maya (People Ops): We still prioritize promotions + market adjustments during the main cycle. Mid-cycle increases are reserved for critical retention cases; managers must propose with ROI + budget code.
Olivia: Can L4s expect a raise with promotion to L5, or is comp separate?
Maya (People Ops): Promotion to L5 includes a compensation review. Typical outcome is base increase + one-time equity refresh in some cases. Not guaranteed; depends on market and role banding.
Ben: Any updates on bonus timing? some teammates expected payout in August per last slide.
Samira (People Ops): Annual bonus payouts are scheduled for Nov 1 this year; the slide was an earlier projection. We'll update the handbook.
Leah: Parental leave — is the enhanced policy permanent or pilot?
Samira (People Ops): Enhanced parental leave is now permanent for all full-time employees, effective immediately. We’ll add wording to the benefits page and notify payroll.
Diego: Where can we see the full leveling rubric?
Maya (People Ops): Link: https://redwood.internal/career-ladders — ladder + examples + manager checklist are there. If anything is unclear, paste the snippet here and we’ll clarify.
Ben: Small ask — could we get a printable one-pager for managers to share in 1:1s?
Maya (People Ops): Yep, we’ll produce a manager cheat sheet and drop it in the People Ops drive by Sep 8.
Olivia: Will there be headcount/budget signals with this cycle? eng managers are asking if hiring freezes affect promotions.
Samira (People Ops): Promotions are evaluated independently from hiring freezes. Compensation budgets may be constrained in some orgs; managers will be informed during calibration if there are limits.
Johan: For transparency: will employees see calibration outcomes / rationale?
Maya (People Ops): We’ll provide outcome notifications and a short rationale summary from the manager. Full calibration notes remain internal to the panel.
Diego: Thanks — that helps. One last thing: is there a fallback for folks who miss the window?
Samira (People Ops): If someone misses the window, managers should plan for the next cycle; we can do ad-hoc exceptions for documented emergencies but they’re rare.
Leah: Appreciate the clarity. tagging @Maya for the template drop. :pray:
Maya (People Ops): On it — will post the template + manager cheat sheet here when ready.
HR Bot: Note: People Ops FAQ doc updated 2026-08-25 13:04 UTC.
Samira (People Ops): Thanks everyone — keep questions coming in this thread or DM @PeopleOps. We’ll close the loop after the docs are live. :v:
